entry.title: New: dsh-bloub-mood
entry.summary: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings. Exact install spec: dsh-bloub-mood. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
